description: Get information about a configuration profile preference

operations.description: Get information about a configuration profile preference

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Fully qualified resource ID for the resource. Ex - /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}
props.name: id

props.description: The geo-location where the resource lives
props.name: location

props.description: Properties of the configuration profile preference.
props.name: properties

props.description: The custom preferences for Azure Antimalware.
props.name: antiMalware

props.name: enableRealTimeProtection

props.description: Extensions, Paths and Processes that must be excluded from scan
props.name: exclusions

props.description: Enables or disables a periodic scan for antimalware
props.name: runScheduledScan

props.description: The custom preferences for Azure VM Backup.
props.name: vmBackup

props.description: Instant RP retention policy range in days
props.name: instantRpRetentionRangeInDays

props.description: Retention policy with the details on backup copy retention ranges.
props.name: retentionPolicy

props.name: schedulePolicy

props.description: TimeZone optional input as string. For example: Pacific Standard Time
props.name: timeZone
